verdict.rationale: SigNoz reduces lock-in through several documented features. Instrumentation is OpenTelemetry/OTLP-native, so telemetry pipelines are portable. The self-hosted open-source edition keeps the data plane under your control, and the stored data is queryable with ClickHouse SQL. Dashboards can be downloaded as JSON and individual panels as CSV. However, nothing in the evidence documents a bulk export of all stored traces, logs and metrics in open formats, or a guide for migrating away. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all telemetry data, export of alerts/saved views/settings, an exit or migration-out guide, independent corroboration of data portability.
